metadata.chapter_subtitle: Getting your computer ready for notebooks, code, GIS, and lab work on Windows, macOS, Linux, and Raspberry Pi

inventory.summary: The original chapter was useful but overlong for its place in the core-book opener. It needed tighter pacing, clearer prioritization, and more reassurance for beginners.
issues: Too much platform detail arrived before the reader had a stable mental model.
The chapter needed stronger emphasis on minimum viable setup.
The sequence needed to privilege recoverability over completeness.

rewrite.summary: Rewrote the full chapter into a shorter, clearer setup guide focused on a stable beginner-safe environment across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Raspberry Pi.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start block.
Moved the minimum viable setup earlier.
Kept platform instructions practical and recoverable.

qa_review.summary: The revised chapter is more proportional to its role in the core-book opening and remains technically sound.

repair.summary: No additional repair pass was needed after the rewrite.
actions_taken: Confirmed that the chapter now foregrounds one-editor, one-Python, one-environment logic.

design_review.summary: The chapter now uses ordered setup sequences and folder examples as its primary explainers, which is the right design choice here.
improvements_made: Improved interpretive support with a clearer install order and sanity-check section.
